title: Legal perspective on possible fairness measures - A legal discussion using the example of hiring decisions
reasoning: The paper's central thesis is a deep analysis and evaluation of the concept of 'fairness' in algorithmic systems. It examines various philosophical and mathematical definitions of fairness (e.g., Independence, Separation, Sufficiency, Counterfactual Fairness), which are inherently ethical concepts. The entire work is dedicated to discussing the moral and legal implications of these different fairness measures, particularly in the context of discrimination and equality, making it fundamentally related to ethics.
